decision.explanation: The provided documents contain conflicting assertions regarding the birth date of General Bryan. Document 1 (D1S3) explicitly states he was born on 'February 8, 1900', while Document 2 (D2S3) states he was born on 'July 15, 1905'. Both documents describe the same individual ('Lieutenant General Blackshear Morrison Bryan') and the same event (birth), creating a direct contradiction. Per the instruction to treat all audits and saved answers as fallible and to preserve separately valid referents/complementary answers where competing assertions exist without evidence to resolve them, both dates are retained as valid candidates found in the source text.
